dkrs.decision_target: Choose the smallest reusable dependency-live finalization and cleanup-order contract across context close, explicit release, shared dependencies, active child turns, and repeated close.
dkrs.stop_rule: Stop when one option has source-backed semantics, executable conformance cases, and independent Claude plus challenger review, or return an unresolved checkpoint.

dkrs.decision_target: Define the semantic session state, ownership, resume, fork, authority fingerprint, turn streaming, and provider continuation contract using the accepted lifecycle primitive.
dkrs.stop_rule: Stop when the database-analysis case distinguishes session-owned durable state from turn-owned runtime resources.

dkrs.decision_target: Choose the migration from legacy agent/session and temporary currentAgent/currentTool surfaces to one resource-native API without carrying duplicate runtime paths.
dkrs.stop_rule: Stop with an API map, compatibility decision, provider impact list, and PR boundary.

orchestrator.terminal_condition: Continue until the objective metric reaches target, the human stops or changes the frame, or a blocking flag requires human resolution.
